instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: As a private higher education institution, Core manages 8,000 students across diverse programs, focusing on business, engineering, and health sciences. We are actively transitioning towards hybrid learning models and seeking to validate micro-credential offerings for executive upskilling. The primary internal challenge involves leveraging student data to predict attrition and design hyper-personalized learning pathways that increase lifetime value.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer developed an internal dashboard to visualize order backlogs, which was informally adopted by the operations team but lacked formal documentation or support. This initiative ultimately failed when the original developer departed and the tool became unreliable; this experience underscored the critical need for a structured innovation pipeline.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is achieving 30% year-over-year top-line growth through market expansion. Leadership is currently evaluating whether to deepen their vertical specialization by becoming industry leaders or broaden horizontally by acquiring adjacent product categories. Success hinges on identifying high-growth, low-risk segments for immediate penetration.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins – there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Attrition Risk Predictor MVP
opportunities.rationale: Incremental improvement of existing retention analytics using low-code tools to identify at-risk students before they drop out. This directly supports the strategic goal of increased student lifetime value with minimal disruption.

first_actions: Identify current data silos for student enrollment and LMS activity.
Select a low-cost SaaS tool or utilize existing internal BI capabilities.
resources_needed: Internal data science time allocation (2 hours weekly)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce annual student attrition rate by 2%
milestones: End of Q1: Data pipeline established and MVP operational.
End of Q2: Pilot program run with 500 students.

opportunities.title: Micro-Credential Platform Partnership
opportunities.rationale: To achieve high growth targets, Core should partner with a specialized EdTech provider to rapidly launch a niche vertical micro-credential that addresses immediate industry skill gaps. This avoids massive internal R&D costs while testing horizontal market appetite.

first_actions: Identify 3 potential high-demand, adjacent industries (e.g., specialized supply chain management).
Develop a lean Business Case focusing solely on partnership revenue share.
resources_needed: $50,000 for market research and legal consultation
Time allocation from Product Manager (1 dedicated quarter)
Internal leadership commitment for strategic alignment
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure a signed partnership agreement within 9 months.
milestones: End of Q3: Identify and vet top 2 partnership targets.
End of Q4: Finalize and initiate pilot program.

next_steps.action: Complete Technical Audit of Current Digital Tools
Develop Pilot Roadmap for Attrition MVP

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal innovation methodology leading to ad-hoc projects.
Extremely high operational bandwidth resulting in zero dedicated time for strategic ideation.
Low digital maturity hindering the implementation and scaling of data-driven solutions.
Conservative risk appetite limiting experimentation and ability to pivot quickly.
